clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Ashenvale, Geltharis holds the Branch of Cenarius, sacred to the dryads. Anilia died defending the relic, and her dying wish was to see it recovered.

The Branch of Cenarius is sacred to the dryads who follow the Forest Lord. Anilia and her sister Illiyana treasured it until corrupt satyrs ambushed them. Their leader, Geltharis, seized the branch and mortally wounded Anilia near the tainted ruins of eastern Ashenvale. As she lay dying, Anilia pointed north toward the arch where Geltharis lurks. She pleaded for a champion to take back the bough and return it to the dryads at Forest Song.
